pli-tv-bi-vb-sk75:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk75:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo udake uccāram pi passāvam pi kheḷam pi karonti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk75:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo udake . . . karissanti seyyathāpi gihikāmabhoginiyo 'ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk75:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk75:1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo . . . karissantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk75:1.8: atha kho bhikkhuniyo bhikkhūnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk75:1.12: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo . . . karontīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk75:1.15: hi nāma bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo . . . karissanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk75:1.18.1: na udake uccāraṃ vā passāvaṃ vā kheḷaṃ vā karissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk75:1.19: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhunīnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||1||
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk75:2.1: tena kho pana samayena gilānā bhikkhuniyo udake uccāram pi passāvam pi kheḷam pi kātuṃ kukkuccāyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk75:2.3: anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānāya bhikkhuniyā udake . . . kātuṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk75:2.4: evañ ca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu:
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk75:2.5.1: na udake agilānā uccāraṃ vā passāvaṃ vā kheḷaṃ vā karissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk75:2.6: na udake agilānāya uccāro vā passāvo vā kheḷo vā kātabbo.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk75:2.7: yā anādariyaṃ paṭicca udake agilānā uccāraṃ vā passāvaṃ vā kheḷaṃ vā karoti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
